name: nightform
description: Nightform by Mothlight Works: an online form builder with branching, formulas, save and resume, live editing and CSV export.

scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:assets: esbuild src/client/styles.css --bundle --minify --external:/assets/* --outfile=dist/public/app.css && mkdir -p dist/public/fonts && cp public/fonts/*.woff2 dist/public/fonts/
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:assets
